name: protege-mais
description: Base inicial do projeto Protege Mais.

scripts.db:up: docker compose up --build -d db atlas-db minio minio-setup atlas
scripts.atlas:run: atlas migrate hash --env ${ENV} --var DB_ATLAS=${DB_ATLAS} && atlas migrate apply --env ${ENV} --var DB_ATLAS=${DB_ATLAS} --url "${DB_DATABASE_URL}"
scripts.atlas:run:docker: docker compose run --rm -T -e ENV -e DB_ATLAS -e DB_DATABASE_URL atlas sh -c 'atlas migrate hash --env ${ENV} --var DB_ATLAS=${DB_ATLAS} && atlas migrate apply --env ${ENV} --var DB_ATLAS=${DB_ATLAS} --url "${DB_DATABASE_URL}"'
scripts.atlas:run:auto: if command -v atlas >/dev/null 2>&1; then pnpm run atlas:run; else echo 'Atlas CLI nao encontrado. Usando Docker (atlas).' && pnpm run atlas:run:docker; fi
scripts.atlas:diff:docker: docker compose run --rm -T -e ENV -e DB_ATLAS atlas sh -c 'atlas migrate diff --env ${ENV} --var DB_ATLAS=${DB_ATLAS}'
scripts.atlas:run:dev: atlas migrate hash --env ${ENV} --var DB_ATLAS=${DB_ATLAS} && atlas migrate apply --exec-order non-linear --env ${ENV} --var DB_ATLAS=${DB_ATLAS} --url "${DB_DATABASE_URL}"
scripts.atlas:run:dev:docker: docker compose run --rm -T -e ENV -e DB_ATLAS -e DB_DATABASE_URL atlas sh -c 'atlas migrate hash --env ${ENV} --var DB_ATLAS=${DB_ATLAS} && atlas migrate apply --exec-order non-linear --env ${ENV} --var DB_ATLAS=${DB_ATLAS} --url "${DB_DATABASE_URL}"'
scripts.seed:local: pnpm run migrate:local && ENV=dev docker compose run --rm -T -e ENV -e DB_ATLAS -e DB_DATABASE_URL atlas sh -c 'atlas migrate hash --env ${ENV} --var DB_ATLAS=${DB_ATLAS} && atlas migrate apply --exec-order non-linear --env ${ENV} --var DB_ATLAS=${DB_ATLAS} --url "${DB_DATABASE_URL}"'
scripts.create:seed:prod: ENV=prod docker compose run --rm -T -e ENV -e DB_ATLAS atlas sh -c 'atlas migrate new --env ${ENV} --var DB_ATLAS=${DB_ATLAS}'
scripts.create:seed:dev: ENV=dev docker compose run --rm -T -e ENV -e DB_ATLAS atlas sh -c 'atlas migrate new --env ${ENV} --var DB_ATLAS=${DB_ATLAS}'
